extra.summary: Elevate your lifestyle with the CIMB World Mastercard. Enjoy exclusive privileges and rewards tailored for discerning individuals. Earn cashback on all your spending, with additional perks such as complimentary travel insurance and gain access at a preferential rate to airport lounges worldwide.

our_takes.our-take: The CIMB World Mastercard is best for those whose spending aligns with its bonus categories: dining, online food delivery, movies, taxis, luxury goods. Hit the S$1,000 monthly spend to unlock the 2% cashback rate; otherwise, general spending earns just 1%. The unlimited cashback is a plus, but the high minimum spend might make it less appealing than other cashback cards with lower thresholds, especially if your spending is spread across various categories. The included lounge access via Mastercard Travel Pass are nice travel perks.
our_takes.good-for:
Ideal for foodies who dine out frequently or order in, maximizing cashback on meals and deliveries.
Perfect for individuals who enjoy movies, digital entertainment, and occasional taxi rides, earning rewards on leisure spending.
Suited for those who appreciate luxury goods and seek cashback on these purchases, coupled with complimentary airport lounge access.
our_takes.things-to-note:
S$100 late payment fee applies; promptly paying dues avoids this substantial charge.
The 27.8% annual interest rate can be costly, so aim to pay your balance in full.
3% foreign transaction fee applies, so factor that when using overseas.
